title: ideas.json
description: The flat, multi-tagged, scored idea-bank that drives production.

updated.description: ISO date this bank was last refreshed.

search_term.description: The query a viewer would type.

subject.description: Optional channel-map coordinate 'branch/leaf' under AI Decision Automation (attention/* · change-detection/* · failure-detection/* · execution/*). Mirrors docs/CHANNEL_MAP.md; pick-next.mjs warns (never blocks) on a same-subject collision with an already-claimed subject in produced_subjects.json (D-059).

series.description: Optional named series this idea belongs to (e.g. "The AI Agent"), orthogonal to `lane`.

angle_hint.description: Seed for the original angle (refined at Gate 1).

score.description: Predicted popularity (the immutable prediction; never overwritten by the analytics loop).

adjusted_score.description: Analytics-informed effective score (T5.2). Set only when it moves off `score`; pickers sort by adjusted_score ?? score.

performance.description: Measured-performance score (0..100) for a produced idea, derived from its metrics.

lane.description: Content lane / series; drives the variety soft-cap (no >2 of the same lane in a row).

takeaway.description: The ONE reusable thing a viewer can apply/believe tomorrow (idea-pass; verified delivered at the script-pass).

value_band.description: Idea-pass gate decision. A 'reject' idea is skipped by the picker.

source.description: Provenance: how this idea entered the bank.

metrics.description: Filled after publish from the YouTube Analytics API (T5.2); used to re-rank the bank.

ctr.description: Click-through rate (fraction), when the API exposes it.

fetched.description: ISO date these metrics were fetched.
